agents.name: architect
agents.description: Senior architect for multi-file architecture and bugs that persist after repeated failed checks. Read-only advice.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Independent reviewer for a second opinion on a design or a diff. Read-only.

agents.name: worker
agents.description: Read-only coding worker for careful reasoning or mechanical edits; returns code for the caller to apply.

agents.name: pr-writer
agents.description: Writes PR.md for the current git branch, with a new branch name, commit message, PR title, and PR body. Reads git only; never commits or pushes.
